title: FreeSWITCH operator
description: The fleets as the operator runs them (members, conditions, rolls and drains), the dispatcher list, address pools, and the controller itself.

panels.title: Operator
panels.description: The operator's metrics endpoint answered the last scrape. Calls go on without the operator, but nothing reacts to a node leaving or a change to a fleet.

panels.title: Fleets ready
panels.description: Fleets whose Ready condition is True, of all the selected fleets.

panels.title: Members taking calls
panels.description: Active members across the selected fleets, against the replicas their specs ask for.

panels.title: Rolling
panels.description: Members not yet on the latest pod template: above zero while a roll is under way.

panels.title: Draining
panels.description: Members finishing their calls before they go.

panels.title: Dispatcher reload pending
panels.description: KamailioClusters whose changed dispatcher list not every Kamailio is confirmed to hold.

panels.title: Fleets
panels.description: Every fleet the operator runs, now: KamailioClusters and FreeswitchClusters.

targets.expr: sum by (kind, namespace, name) (freeswitch_operator_fleet_members{namespace=~"$namespace", name=~"$fleet", state="Active"})
sum by (kind, namespace, name) (freeswitch_operator_fleet_members{namespace=~"$namespace", name=~"$fleet", state="Starting"})
sum by (kind, namespace, name) (freeswitch_operator_fleet_members{namespace=~"$namespace", name=~"$fleet", state="Draining"})
max by (kind, namespace, name) (freeswitch_operator_fleet_condition{namespace=~"$namespace", name=~"$fleet", condition="Ready"})
max by (kind, namespace, name) (freeswitch_operator_fleet_condition{namespace=~"$namespace", name=~"$fleet", condition="Available"})
max by (kind, namespace, name) (freeswitch_operator_fleet_condition{namespace=~"$namespace", name=~"$fleet", condition="Progressing"})
max by (kind, namespace, name) (freeswitch_operator_fleet_condition{namespace=~"$namespace", name=~"$fleet", condition="Degraded"})

panels.title: Members by state
panels.description: Starting: not ready yet. Active: takes calls. Draining: terminating, finishing its calls.

panels.title: Conditions
panels.description: Each fleet's status conditions. Degraded: fewer members take calls than asked for. SetConflict (KamailioCluster): two fleets claim the same dispatcher set.

panels.title: Rolls
panels.description: Outdated: members not on the latest pod template. Replaced: pods the operator deleted to move them to it; each drains first.

panels.title: Drains in progress
panels.description: How long each draining pod has drained, against its fleet's drain.maxDrainSeconds. At the limit the pod goes with whatever calls it still has.

targets.expr: max by (name) (freeswitch_operator_fleet_max_drain_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", name=~"$fleet"}) and on (name) count by (name) (freeswitch_operator_fleet_drain_started_timestamp_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace", name=~"$fleet"})

panels.title: Drains over the range
panels.description: Drains that finished in the selected range and how long they took. A Kamailio drain takes seconds; a FreeSWITCH drain waits for its calls.

panels.title: Destinations by set
panels.description: Nodes in each KamailioCluster's dispatcher list, by set.

panels.title: List writes and reloads
panels.description: The operator writes the list when a fleet changes, asks every Kamailio to reload it, and marks a leaving node inactive first so no new call goes to it.

panels.title: Reload pending
panels.description: Pending: the list changed and not every Kamailio is confirmed to hold it yet.

panels.title: Addresses by state
panels.description: Bound: on a node running the pool's pods. Free and Idle: spare. Conflict or Error: the provider disagrees with the pool; see the SIPAddressPool's status.

panels.title: Nodes and addresses waiting
panels.description: Nodes running a pod that uses the pool with none of its addresses, and bound addresses whose node's address agent hasn't reported them on the node's interface. Either keeps the node's pods from advertising a public address.

panels.title: Provider
panels.description: Calls to the cloud provider (observe, bind, unbind, prune), and how long since the pool last read it. It rereads every 5 minutes.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Reconciles that returned an error (retried with backoff), terminal errors (not retried), and Kubernetes API requests that didn't succeed (409 conflicts are routine).

panels.title: Work queue depth
panels.description: Objects waiting for a worker. Steadily above zero means the controller can't keep up.

panels.title: Time in queue, p99
panels.description: How long an object waits before a reconcile picks it up.
